The source identifies the act as published in 'Služben vesnik' no. 59/2001, and the corpus likely records the in-force date from an internal enactment/adoption date rather than the publication date. Under North Macedonian rules, official acts normally take effect on publication unless a different commencement is expressly provided, so a pre-publication 'in-force' label is a metadata problem unless the text itself gives retroactive effect.
